caption: The drawing depicts a pair of women's shoes rendered in soft, neutral tones, primarily white or light gray. The shoes have a closed-toe design, low chunky heels, and appear to be made of a smooth fabric. Each shoe is adorned with a round, fluffy pom-pom attached to the upper front. The composition shows the pair positioned near the upper center, viewed in a three-quarters perspective, with one shoe partly overlapping the other. Below and to the right, there is a separate depiction of a single shoe shown from a top-down view, providing a clear view of its interior and the pom-pom ornament. The background is plain and unadorned, light beige in color, ensuring that the shoes are the focal point of the drawing.
title: Woman's Slippers
